steps.comment: Base system: host name, DNS, NTP
steps.note: NSIP, netmask and default route come from first boot. DNS must resolve the STA/StoreFront/IdP names used later. NTP sync matters: SAML assertions and OIDC tokens are time checked. All four are [MANUAL] in the journal (undo does not remove them).
A fresh 14.1 VPX has it DISABLED: new SSL vservers then allow SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1 and no TLS1.3. The CLI asks Y/N, NITRO does not. Cannot be undone (MANUAL) - take a snapshot first.

steps.comment: Least-privilege NITRO user for certificate deployment (e.g. netscaler-acme), no nsroot
steps.note: Password only via environment: $env:CERT_USER_PW = Read-Host 'password' -MaskInput. The binding is the LAST step on purpose: if anything fails after it, the rollback has least to do.
